Technology Partners

Global Technology. Local Integration.

Strong technology partnerships are fundamental to the S3 approach.

01 / S3

Modern mission-critical solutions often require technologies and expertise from multiple specialized organizations. S3 works with established international manufacturers and experienced integration partners to bring advanced technologies, specialist knowledge, and proven solutions to our customers in Uzbekistan.

Our role is to connect this international expertise with local requirements, systems integration, training, knowledge transfer, and lifecycle support.

The result is more than access to technology.

It is a partnership model designed to transform advanced technologies into sustainable operational capabilities.

03 / S3

Our Partnership Approach

S3 develops partnerships with technology manufacturers and organizations whose products, expertise, and capabilities complement our systems integration portfolio.

When evaluating technologies and potential partners, we consider factors including:

  • Proven technology and operational reliability
  • Security and resilience
  • Interoperability
  • Technical performance
  • Integration capabilities
  • Product and technology lifecycle
  • Availability of manufacturer expertise
  • Training and knowledge-transfer capabilities
  • Technical and lifecycle support
  • Compatibility with customer requirements and existing environments

Our objective is not to build the largest possible list of vendors.

We aim to develop a strong technology ecosystem that allows S3 to select and integrate appropriate technologies according to each customer's operational and technical requirements.

04 / S3

L3Harris Technologies

Combat-Proven Technology for Mission-Critical Operations

L3Harris Technologies is a key technology partner supporting S3's mission to provide advanced solutions to government and defense customers.

L3Harris provides technologies across mission-critical areas including secure tactical communications, resilient communications and networks, Command and Control (C2), ISR, and integrated mission systems.

Its portfolio enables secure connectivity and information exchange across users, networks, platforms, sensors, and command-and-control environments.

For S3, cooperation with L3Harris provides access not only to advanced technology but also to specialist product knowledge, engineering expertise, training resources, and technical support.

S3 complements these capabilities through local customer engagement, systems integration, deployment support, training, knowledge transfer, and lifecycle services in Uzbekistan.

Together, these capabilities support our approach:

Global Technology → Local Integration → Operational Capability

05 / S3

From Communications to Integrated Systems

Our cooperation with L3Harris supports S3 capabilities in areas such as:

  • Secure tactical radio communications
  • Tactical networking
  • Command and Control (C2)
  • Situational awareness
  • Secure voice and data exchange
  • Communications and network planning
  • Integrated tactical communication systems
  • System interoperability
  • Training and knowledge transfer
  • Technical and lifecycle support

The objective is not simply to provide individual L3Harris products.

S3 works to integrate these technologies into complete solutions designed around customer requirements and, where technically feasible, to connect new capabilities with systems and infrastructure already in operation.

This reflects one of our core integration principles:

Modernization Without Starting From Zero.

06 / S3

Digital Technologies (DTECH)

Integration Experience. Technical Expertise. Regional Cooperation.

Digital Technologies (DTECH) is an experienced technology and systems integration company based in Georgia and an important partner in S3's development and delivery of mission-critical solutions.

DTECH brings extensive experience in military technologies, professional radio communications, networking solutions, systems integration, training, and technical support.

Its team includes specialists with expertise across tactical communications, networking, integration, training, and technical assistance.

Cooperation between S3 and DTECH allows us to combine local presence in Uzbekistan with additional regional integration experience and specialist technical resources.

07 / S3

Working Together

S3 and DTECH cooperate across areas including:

  • Solution development
  • Systems integration
  • Tactical communications
  • Network solutions
  • Technical consultancy
  • Deployment and configuration
  • Customer training
  • Train-the-Trainer programs
  • Technical assistance
  • Troubleshooting
  • Knowledge transfer
  • Lifecycle support

This cooperation also provides S3 with access to DTECH's broader technical experience and established relationships with international technology manufacturers.

Together, our teams can bring complementary expertise to complex customer requirements while maintaining strong local engagement through S3.
